stack: Google Apps Script HTML with Bootstrap 5.3 and existing POS CSS tokens

decisions.direction: Recorded shop fee in the payment summary
decisions.details: Display Shop-absorbed fee with its saved peso amount after the payment reference and before the Transaction Total separator. Sum the existing per-item feeAbsorbed values once per Sales Log row, excluding fully VOIDED rows in line with the existing total. Include adjusted rows and reservation stages without multiplying by quantity or recalculating current fee rates. Hide the row for zero or missing fees and clear it before a new receipt fetch to prevent stale display. Reuse the existing payment panel typography, alignment and colors. Preserve saved totals, permissions, fetches, fields and actions. Dev only; no backend or sheet changes.

decisions.direction: Separate compact payment cards with the standard centered total
decisions.details: Use the approved compact-split-checkout preview. Split payments show two individually bordered cards, with the method and received amount on the same row, shorter reference labels, compact spacing, the standard centered Total due label, larger amount and remaining-balance subtitle, plus a compact change bar. Use Cash plus GCash as both the initial markup and per-open split defaults. Leave received fields blank and preserve independent unequal amounts. Compact styling is scoped to split mode; turning split off restores the existing centered total, four payment buttons and normal cash/digital fields. Keep fees off by default, references, calculations, success screen, scrollable content, accessible close/action areas, retry and focus behavior unchanged. Reuse current controls and design tokens. Dev only; no backend or sheet changes. Follow-up: keep the supplied centered pink Total due format in split mode too; remove the split-only horizontal/size overrides. The remaining balance stays centered under the amount and hides when covered.

decisions.direction: One actual received amount per method
decisions.details: Remove Sale amount fields and their equal half default. Split methods occupy full width; each payment has a single Cash received or Amount received field. Both start blank and editing either never fills or changes the other. Accept arbitrary positive portions that cover the sale, including 100 Cash plus 20 GCash on a 120 Yellow item, in either method order. Treat extra cash as change. Digital amounts include any customer-paid fee; keep existing flags and convert received amounts into sale portions for the existing backend. Fee switches adjust only their own received amount to retain its sale portion. Preserve time/reference fields, fee-off defaults, remaining balance, gray/green change bar, scrolling content, retry/busy/focus controls and confirmation. Dev only; no sheet or backend changes required.

decisions.direction: Single payment buttons, optional split payments and compact confirmation
decisions.details: Implement the approved checkout previews in existing Apps Script/Bootstrap components. Split payment and customer fee switches default off; QR fee is 1% and card fee is 3.2%, applied only to each allocated sale portion. Four single methods and distinct two-method combinations share time plus four alphanumeric reference fields. Keep remaining cash due below the total only while unpaid, gray/green Change due, fixed close/action areas with scrolling content, and one full-width Complete order action. Confirmation restores centered check, title and subtitle; receipt, Total paid, actual Cash received and digital amounts/references, plain Change given row, and full-width New transaction. Preserve authorization, busy locking, retry data, stock writes, exchange and reservation handlers. Existing callers omitting the optional QR flag retain their previous fee behavior. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Soft cloudy pink with subtle grain
decisions.details: Match the supplied pink background reference using only CSS radial/linear gradients; no photo, SVG texture or image URL. Use a lighter palette with a broader pale highlight toward the upper left/center and soft pink toward the right/bottom. Paint a fixed, pointer-transparent CSS backdrop behind the active Dashboard through body::before, with the same gradient on the root canvas for scroll edges. Keep body/page/workspace surfaces transparent so the background is independent of their height and stays fixed during scrolling. Restore the ordinary workspace background when Dashboard is hidden. Fill the available viewport during initial loading, accounting for the existing mobile top bar. Preserve the greeting, opaque card/modal surfaces, typography, layout, business logic and other workspace backgrounds. Dev only; no image assets or external requests for the background.

decisions.direction: Shared native-dialog shell with content and action slots
decisions.details: All seven dashboard dialogs (Inventory, Delivery, Return, Sales, Units sold, Transactions and Date range) use DashboardModal. The component creates one common header and close button, a scrolling body and persistent footer from each instance's existing heading/content/action nodes. Summary width is 680px; date range uses the same shell's 420px compact variant. Reuse app spacing, control, radius, shadow, typography, pink, neutral, danger and focus tokens. Close sits top right with an accessible label and initial focus. Secondary actions stay left, primary stays right; Transactions gains a secondary Close action. Keep native modality and opener restoration plus explicit keyboard focus wrapping, safe Escape and reduced-motion-aware open/close animation. Busy report downloads disable close and secondary actions and block dismissal/navigation until completion; explicit logout cleanup remains possible. Errors use alert semantics and common danger feedback styling, ordinary messages remain neutral. There are no destructive actions in these seven dialogs. All six summary tables use the shared dashboard-modal-total class: pink surface and rose ink, 2px top divider, equal padding, 500 weight and matching label/value typography (14px desktop, 13px phone), with inherited strong text, small neutral unit labels and sticky positioning. Remove the former per-modal total styles and keep column alignment and all quantities/amounts. Keep data, field IDs, radio/date selection, validation, cache, permissions, report generation and navigation handlers. No unrelated dashboard or application redesign; dev only.

decisions.direction: Daily totals, cashier expansion and merged receipt report
decisions.details: Transactions card opens the approved capped modal with Date, Transactions, Average sale and Sales. Ascending dates expand only into cashier totals; no item-category expansion. Use a weighted grand average from total net sales divided by distinct receipts, matching the card. Cache the complete summary and receipt details in the existing dashboard read. The A4 TRANSACTIONS REPORT SUMMARY uses Cashier, Receipt, Time, Payment, Received, Change and Sales. Place daily transaction count, average and sales on the right of each date band. Merge the first-column cashier cells and write names horizontally, with enough width for full names to wrap naturally. Empty dates display No record in the date band only, without a separate message row, zero metrics or daily total. Put an exchange's original receipt as a gray subtitle directly under its receipt number, without an Exchange label or explanatory subtitle. Retain daily totals, pink grand total and authenticated Prepared by signature on the right. In the modal, empty dates use a single pink date row with No record spanning the numeric columns, without zeros, expansion or a separate empty-period message. Compact report rows use 5px vertical padding, 7px date/subtotal padding and 8px gaps before dates, preserving readable text. Deduplicate repeated received/change and split allocations, preserve existing exchange reporting anchors and reservation payment stages; missing historical tender values use an em dash. Preserve manager/OIC detail access, cashier redaction, download spinner/retry/logout guards and cached opens. Dev only; no sheet or financial-write changes.

decisions.direction: Inventory-style grouped modal and coded report
decisions.details: Units sold card opens the approved capped scrolling modal with Description, Price, Units sold and Total sales. Pink category bands for YourFinds · Size, YourStyle · Pins, YourStyle · Others and Wholesale; neutral item text, no status colors or item subtitles. Group YourFinds by size and other items by normalized inventory description, combining historical prices into a range and preserving recorded net amounts rather than multiplying quantity by price. Category subtotals and grand totals align under units/sales. The PDF uses Code, Description, Price, Units sold and Total sales with full-width inventory category bands; YF code is size with long size description, other codes are listed. Reuse sales report pink header/total, bold rose YourStyle title, date period and authenticated Prepared by signature on the right. Include in cached dashboard sales payload; no fetch on modal open. Preserve spinner/retry/logout guards, date permissions and transaction navigation. Dev only; no sheet changes. Follow-up: group by category and code, with YourFinds using its size code (all SNE in one row). Same code with different historical descriptions or prices stays one row. Price displays min - max, or a single amount when equal; quantities and recorded sales are summed unchanged. Apply to modal and PDF, retaining existing category order. Keep regular and sale pricing in separate rows for each code/size, with independent min/max ranges. Append · SALE and render the entire sale row red in modal and PDF; regular rows, category bands and totals retain normal colors.

decisions.direction: Ascending dates, grouped report columns and preparer signature
decisions.details: Implement the approved sales-report-clear preview. Dates run from the selected first day to the last in both modal and PDF. Modal collapsed rows are uniformly white; only expanded date rows are pink. Remove visible Expected collection(s) and Expand dates by text, retaining the Payment method / Cashier controls. The PDF uses Date, Payment method (or Cashier), Sales columns with a pink date cell spanning each day, weekday labels, white detail rows, distinct pink daily subtotals and grand total, aligned two-decimal currency. Add one signature line below the grand total with the authenticated account name above Prepared by. Resolve that name at download time from the actor; never accept a caller-provided name or store it in shared sales caches. Preserve calculations, shift grouping, permissions, download spinner and cached reads. Dev only; no sheet changes. Add a visible 2px muted rose divider across all three columns before each subsequent date group, with compact padding. Mark the actual first row of each date so the divider survives PDF conversion and background printing being off. Highlight the report grand total in a pink band matching the table header (#f2dede) with a 2px #e3c6c6 outer border and bold #65454b text and an 18px amount. Retain space above the total and the Prepared by signature below. Use explicit bgcolor attributes and print-color-adjust:exact so the highlight survives PDF conversion and background printing being disabled. Match the reference report table header: #f2dede pink fill, thin #e3c6c6 cell borders, bold #65454b labels, with Date / Payment method or Cashier / Sales unchanged. Match YourStyle to the inventory report title typography: Arial, 20px, 700 weight, #b76e79 rose, with exact print-color retention. Align the entire 60mm Prepared by signature block at the right content edge, keeping the name and role centered under the signature line.

decisions.direction: Date totals with payment or named cashier expansion
decisions.details: Use the approved Sales summary modal: Date / Sales (Expected collection), independently expandable date rows, Payment method / Cashier radios, recorded cashier names with real shift times, zero-collection dates, sticky grand total and capped scrolling. Load all details in the cached dashboard sales response. The A4 SALES REPORT SUMMARY includes all dates, selected breakdown, daily subtotals and final grand total regardless of collapsed modal rows. Expected customer collections use recorded split allocations once per payment event, plus charged fees; non-split collections add shop-absorbed and customer-charged fees back to net revenue. No separate customer-fee row. Keep net revenue cards/chart unchanged, original reporting date/cashier attribution, existing cashier privacy, spinner/retry behavior and transaction navigation. Managers/OICs can view cashier details; cashier accounts receive payment totals only. Dev code only; no spreadsheet schema changes.

decisions.direction: Compact tooltip above the hovered point
decisions.details: Apply the approved compact preview: content-fitted width, 10px outer padding, 6px column gaps, 12px regular text, 10px corners, soft shadow and bottom pointer anchored to the hovered point. Use a short date/time header without calendar icon. Show only selected categories with nonzero units or net sales; retain refunds even with zero units. Show whole-peso values while preserving underlying precision. Keep both totals under their respective columns in the pink footer and leave 8px of pink padding after the last amount, aligning the same inset on the sales column. Allow the panel above the plot, clamped to the viewport top rather than flipped below the point. Preserve cached reads, hourly/daily/weekly buckets, filters and navigation. Dev only. The tooltip panel, caret and pink footer backgrounds use their existing theme colors at 85% opacity via color-mix; text retains its normal color.

decisions.direction: Six visible rows with scrolling
decisions.details: Increase the top-selling scroll box from five to six visible item rows using the existing responsive row-height variable. Keep every ranked result accessible by scrolling; preserve filters, rank order and totals. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Close filters on outside click or tap
decisions.details: Both Sales & units sold and Top selling items filters close on a pointer outside their own details container. Interactions with category and grouping controls inside keep that filter open; opening another filter closes the previous one. Preserve all filter selections. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Both grouping checkboxes with All categories
decisions.details: Show Group by code and Group by size even when no specific category is selected (All categories). Apply selected grouping per category: code to Pins and size to YourFinds, preserving other categories. For a specific category keep the relevant option and preserve checkbox choices when switching. Keep ranking, quantities, amounts and existing item images. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Compact presets without Last year
decisions.details: Remove the Last year shortcut. Arrange remaining seven shortcuts in a compact four-column grid (three columns on narrow phones). Use 34px minimum button height, smaller padding and regular 12px text, preserving 44px touch targets on coarse pointers. Keep existing date-range selection, presets and Apply/Cancel behavior. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Matching preview/edit sizes, subtle border and click to view
decisions.details: Preview and edit avatars share the existing 104px desktop / 72px phone size. Apply a one-pixel muted border using the existing border token to the profile avatar and sidebar avatar. In account preview, clicking a valid photo opens the existing native image viewer using the rendered cached JPEG, without a data fetch. Retain initial avatars when no photo exists and the separate edit-photo button. No sheet/storage changes. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Direct Inventory, Delivery and Return rows
decisions.details: Match the supplied screenshot: Stock and receiving heading followed by three peer rows labeled Inventory, Delivery, Return. In the expanded desktop sidebar and mobile drawer, show these direct links and hide the inventory chevron and menu toggle. Only the collapsed desktop rail keeps the Inventory flyout. Highlight the selected page in expanded navigation and the inventory group in the collapsed rail. Preserve Dashboard, Cashier and footer navigation. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Rounded dashboard overview tiles
decisions.details: Replace the text grid glyph with the approved four rounded overview tiles, matching the layout-dashboard preview. Use the existing nav-icon size, currentColor, 1.8px rounded outline and existing active navigation styling. Preserve expanded/collapsed accessibility labels and navigation. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Daily transparent mascot in a compact chart card
decisions.details: When the loaded date range has no sales activity, show the approved 180px transparent cat mascot in a compact 360px empty state. Do not stretch the card to the sales metrics column. Let the supporting sentence use the full card width, wrapping naturally on narrow screens. Bundle the 20 approved PNGs in the app and inline only the current Manila calendar day artwork into the page; cache it in memory and fetch only the next selection on day rollover. Before noon rotate the daily mascot; from noon through 11:59 PM always use the sad mascot in Asia/Manila time, including the initial server image. Keep time-aware copy, chart restoration, category filters, dates, loading/error behavior and report totals. Dev only.

decisions.direction: Approved compact profile preview and editor
decisions.details: Avatar opens account preview. Personal details and a masked Password row with Change password are on the left. Compact photo, display name and username are on the right, followed by read-only Employee ID, Role and Date hired. Email appears only in personal details. Edit uses paired fields, a photo pencil and Save/Cancel. Full name, display name, email, birthday, contact, address and optional emergency contact are editable profile values. Original login/report names remain unchanged. Separate current/new/confirm password view; successful password change requires sign-in again. Dev code only; matching additive Employees I:V schema in dev and prod. Store photos in the selected EMPLOYEES Drive folder, save a file ID in column V, and display a cached small JPEG through the authenticated app. Preserve the folder sharing chosen by the user.

decisions.direction: Accessible warm retail system
decisions.details: Dev-only cohesive application polish: user-supplied #E1BFC5 main pink, with dark rose #642D40 labels for contrast and soft pink surfaces; shared spacing, borders, control heights, focus and status tokens. Keep the approved dashboard. Preserve vanilla JavaScript, Bootstrap, IDs, backend contracts, calculations, permissions and authentication. Phone cashier retains Add items/Cart and sticky checkout; Inventory, Deliveries and Supplier returns use labeled record cards with explicit sort controls. Shared dialog focus handling delegates to existing close handlers. Phone inventory filters apply from a bottom panel. No new production dependency.

decisions.direction: Action tabs
decisions.details: Separate Distribute items and Split bundle panels. Center bundle navigation; use toggles up to three bundles and a dropdown for more. Put Add Item beside the item table. Keep only the selected bundle count and remove Delivery Summary cards.

decisions.direction: Personal greeting
decisions.details: Use a soft pink header with a time-of-day greeting, the employee’s first name, and a daily encouraging line. Place the date-range dropdown at the right of the header.

decisions.direction: Approved pink overview and sales layout
decisions.details: Three overview cards; three sales metrics beside a combined stacked-units chart and thin shadowed white net-sales line. Show Daily/Weekly radios outside the graph filter for multi-day ranges. Put By qty/By amount radios outside the top-selling filter; retain its category dropdown, Pins code grouping and YourFinds size grouping. Five visible ranked rows with photos and medal stars. Payment legend above the donut; hover or focus enlarges a segment and updates the center amount, method, share and actual shop-absorbed fee, without a tooltip. All dashboard PDF buttons replace their download icon with a spinner while busy, without Preparing text. Cache the complete dashboard and use one loader below the header. Enable this dashboard in dev and live production.

decisions.direction: YourStyle services form using existing cashier controls
decisions.details: YourStyle services uses a single editable Description input with native Steam and Place rent suggestions; staff can type any service directly in the same field, up to 100 characters. Do not show Category or a separate Custom field. Set SERVICE in the sale payload automatically. Keep Price (₱) and Add service with existing retail tokens, validation, manual custom-sale handling, inventory bypass and checkout behavior. Dev only. Hide the services card initially behind a small Add service text button. It toggles the card without clearing entered values, exposes aria-expanded/aria-controls and focuses Description when opened. Keep the toggle within the existing disabled cashier fieldset. Center the Add service toggle. Put Description and Price in one row (8/4 Bootstrap columns), including phone layouts. Reset and collapse the service form after successful checkout and New Transaction; retain it on cancellation/failure. Restore CUSTOM- plus five digits, avoiding codes already in the current cart. SERVICE custom sales and sales-sync paths skip inventory creation and movement.

decisions.direction: One scan or search field
decisions.details: Combine barcode scanning and manual product lookup in the existing scanner surface. Label Scan or search a product, preserve codeInput for cashier/checkout focus, reuse the indexed product search dropdown and Add to Cart button. Typing filters by code, name, size or category. Enter adds a unique exact code or single match; multiple price variants require explicit choice. Arrow keys plus Enter choose and add a match, mouse selection uses Add to Cart, Escape/outside click close suggestions, and editing invalidates the selected product. Keep shared combobox ARIA behavior, existing barcode index/cache, bundle/cart logic and service toggle. Dev only. Remove the redundant scanner subtitle. Enter invokes the actual Add to Cart button. A unique exact barcode adds automatically after a 180ms input pause, without needing a scanner Enter suffix; cancel pending adds on edits, key navigation, blur, reset and explicit adds. Reject automatic matches while composing, unfocused, hidden, disabled or after account changes. Multiple prices require selection and known longer-code prefixes wait for completion or Enter. Keep price choices open when the add button is invoked and avoid duplicate adds from scanner Enter suffixes.

decisions.direction: Single-row filters with role-aware date controls
decisions.details: Place From–To, Search and Payment Method in one responsive desktop row using the existing Bootstrap grid and retail controls. Reuse the Dashboard date-range dialog; hide its shortcut presets for cashier accounts while retaining them for managers. Do not show an additional cashier date-visibility note. A stalled background history warm-up must fall back to the visible modal request after 1.5 seconds so loading always progresses. Preserve date permissions, search, sorting, payment filtering, summaries and responsive stacking. Dev only.
